SmartSites and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Compare SmartSites vs VEXI side-by-side. See pricing, features, and why 1,000+ realtors choose VEXI for done-for-you social media.

SmartSites is a digital marketing agency offering SEO, PPC, email and SMS, social media and web design [1]. VEXI makes posts, videos, designs and captions from what you ask for. The two overlap on social media, and in many ways they fit together.

SmartSites is a family-run digital marketing agency started in 2011, with 370+ team members and clients in all 50 states [1]. SmartSites’ services cover organic SEO, PPC advertising, email and SMS marketing, social media marketing and web design, for industries from home services and healthcare to legal, retail and real estate [1]. SmartSites’ social media management starts at $1,700 a month for 8 posts, and its websites start at $5,000 as a one-time project fee [2][3].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on social media and work in different ways. Here is what each one does.

SmartSites’ social team plans a monthly content calendar of custom graphics, short-form video, reels and captions for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest and X [2]. It edits the photos and footage you send into posts and reels, and says it does not shoot video or photography itself [2].

SmartSites lists social media management at $1,700 a month for 8 posts, $2,750 for 16 posts and $4,000 for 24 posts, each with a monthly boosting budget included and free setup [2]. Its packages cover up to four platforms [2].

SmartSites sends each month’s content calendar to you for approval before anything is posted, and shows results in its Client Hub next to the website visits, calls and form leads your social media sends [2]. It meets with you at least once a month to review results [2].
SmartSites works with businesses in many industries, from home services, healthcare and ecommerce to legal and real estate [1][2].

How much does SmartSites charge for social media management?

SmartSites lists three social media packages: $1,700 a month for 8 posts, $2,750 for 16 posts and $4,000 for 24 posts, with $250, $500 or $750 of boosted posts included [2]. SmartSites’ setup is free, and its websites start at $5,000 as a one-time project fee [2][3].
Does SmartSites have a client dashboard?
Yes. SmartSites clients get a Client Hub with a monthly social media report, a publishing calendar, every post to review and approve, and a competitor library [2].
Can I approve SmartSites posts before they go live?
Yes. SmartSites sends the content calendar to you for approval each month, and says nothing goes live until you approve it [2].
